findings: ZIP 74462 (Stigler) has 21 nonprofit organizations. 5 of them (24%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.

Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 74462 (Stigler) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
60% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
